title: Swag: A Large-Scale Adversarial Dataset for Grounded Commonsense Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the dataset against shallow, partial-input baselines (such as ending-only models, length-based classifiers, and bag-of-words/fastText models) to detect predictable stylistic patterns, and using an iterative Adversarial Filtering (AF) algorithm with an ensemble of stylistic classifiers to identify and remove these biases during dataset construction.
